clips.name: Bukayo Saka
clips.caption: Standing on the pitch in match action, the player wears a predominantly white England away shirt with blue shoulder gradient trim, navy shorts and white socks. Visible squad number 17 on both the front of the shirt and the shorts, England crest on the chest and a small Nike logo; no visible sponsor. Dark-skinned, short curly hair, athletic/lean build.

clips.name: Bradley Barcola
clips.caption: Young male player wearing a blue shirt with dark diagonal pattern and white collar; shirt has squad number 12 on the front and a small French Football Federation rooster crest on the chest. Short-to-medium braided hair, athletic/lean build, standing on-pitch in match action rather than a posed portrait. No visible commercial sponsor on the shirt.

clips.name: William Saliba
clips.caption: Player wearing a dark navy training/top with light blue trim on the sleeves, white sponsor text "randstad", Puma logo and a white club crest (Olympique de Marseille) on the chest. Visible small white squad number "2" on the front; white shorts are partially visible. Short, dark hair with a low fade, athletic/lean build; image appears to be pre-match or warm-up action rather than a posed portrait.

clips.name: Luis Díaz
clips.caption: Front-facing waist-up match action image of a player in a yellow shirt with red trim on the shoulders and sleeve cuffs. Visible squad number 14 on the front and a Colombia national team crest on the left chest; an adidas logo is on the right chest. Short dark hair with a high fade, athletic/lean build, captured during play on a grass pitch.

clips.name: Bukayo Saka
clips.caption: Three-quarter view of a male footballer in a red England away/alternate shirt with navy trim on the collar and sleeve cuffs; the shirt bears the England crest on the chest and visible squad number 7 on the front. He has short, tightly curled dark hair, a lean athletic build, and is wearing dark navy shorts. Image is match action on the pitch (outdoor stadium) rather than a posed portrait.

clips.name: Michael Olise
clips.caption: Close-up portrait (not match action) of a young male player with short dreadlocks pulled back and a lean athletic build. He is wearing a blue national-team shirt with darker diagonal patterning, a white collar, orange Nike swoosh and a golden rooster crest; visible squad number 11 on the chest. No other sponsor logos are visible.

clips.name: Rodri
clips.caption: Match-action close-up of a male player in a red Spain national team shirt with navy and yellow trim. Visible yellow squad number 16 on the front, Spain crest on the chest and an Adidas logo; a captains armband is partly visible on the right sleeve. Short dark hair, light stubble, athletic build; image shows in-game action rather than a posed portrait.

clips.name: Luis Díaz
clips.caption: Casual portrait-style image of a man wearing a red football training/replica shirt with lighter red trim; shirt features a white club crest with the letters "L.F.C." and a white Nike swoosh, plus part of a white sponsor logo visible. He is seated, wearing a black backwards cap, red-tinted sunglasses, short facial hair and a medium athletic build; not in match action.
